reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Butter-blinded Brahman (Book III); the two-level frame (Slow-Poison telling the bigger snake, inside Live-Strong's account to the crow king) is stated correctly, and the Brahman label is dropped and disclosed.
Age band 16+, shelved in the adults' library section: every plot beat from Ryder is kept, and the double deceit in a goddess's name keeps its wit and edge.
The lover's killing is kept in three calm, non-graphic sentences; the wife's nose-cutting is omitted, disclosed in the changes and in both content notes, and the ending keeps real consequences.
The narrator never says butter causes blindness; the 'goddess' voice is shown to be the husband and the wife's belief is reported as hers. No em dashes.

2026-10-08: the coordinator moved this story from the collection slug doddavara-kathegalu to chitrakathe (the section was renamed ಚಿತ್ರಕಥೆ); only the collection and image path fields changed, the text and art are unchanged.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, 321 KB; the uneven generated rows (about 512/492/532 px) were scaled uniformly and centre-cropped to exact 512 px panels, as the credit line says; seams crisp at x=512 and y=512/1024.
No deity is drawn: panel 3 shows a dark, empty inner doorway and the husband behind a pillar. No violence or body anywhere; panel 6 shows only the wife walking away with a bundle.

Everyone is fully clothed (one edit gave the lover a shirt under his shawl); no caste markers on the men; similar skin tones. After review the credit line notes that the edit re-rendered the sheet with slight drift, and one alt text was corrected to match the picture.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children, parents or adult readers.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.
Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels, not in the app in dark mode.
